items.title_zh: 让互联网更适合 AI 智能体，可能让其他人更难受
items.title_en: Making the internet better for AI agents might make it worse for everyone else
items.summary_zh: 《麻省理工科技评论》旗下 AI 通讯《The Algorithm》的一篇文章指出，长期以来互联网用户基本只分两类：机器人和人。网站允许机器人执行抓取网页等自动化任务，但对其可访问的内容和行为设有规则；毕竟网络主要是为人设计的，人偶尔还得解谜、过验证码来证明自己不是机器人。文章认为，随着个人 AI 智能体的推出，这套建立在“人机二分”之上的规则正在被彻底打破，并可能给普通用户带来负面影响。
items.summary_en: This story originally appeared in The Algorithm, our weekly newsletter on AI. To get stories like this in your inbox first, sign up here . Until recently, you could divide internet users into just two categories: bots and people. Websites have long allowed bots to perform automated tasks, like capturing the content of web pages, but rules govern what they can access and how they behave. The web, after all, is designed primarily for people, even if we occasionally have to solve puzzles and captchas to prove we are not bots. But this is being entirely upended by the release of personal AI agents…
items.why_zh: 个人 AI 智能体正在改写互联网沿用人机二分规则，网站访问权与内容生态的再分配将影响所有普通用户。
items.why_en: Personal AI agents are upending the web's bot-versus-human rules, reshaping who gets access to content and at what cost to ordinary users.

items.title_zh: Collage, a Management Company, Launches as Bridge for AI Studios, Hollywood
items.title_en: Collage, a Management Company, Launches as Bridge for AI Studios, Hollywood
items.summary_zh: Collage, a Management Company, Launches as Bridge for AI Studios, Hollywood Variety

items.why_zh: 若 AI 内容生产与好莱坞传统体系之间出现专门的经纪与管理中介，意味着两条产业链正在加速融合。
items.why_en: A dedicated intermediary between AI studios and Hollywood signals that the two production ecosystems are beginning to converge.

items.title_zh: Monday.com 推出 Harmony：面向销售通话的语音 AI 平台
items.title_en: Monday.com launches Harmony, a voice AI platform for sales calls
items.summary_zh: 据 The Next Web 报道，工作管理平台 Monday.com 发布了名为 Harmony 的语音 AI 平台，聚焦销售通话场景。该产品将语音 AI 能力引入销售沟通环节，具体功能细节、定价与上线范围在此次报道中未充分展开。这标志着 Monday.com 在其项目管理主业之外，进一步向销售科技与对话式 AI 领域延伸。
items.summary_en: Monday.com launches Harmony, a voice AI platform for sales calls The Next Web
items.why_zh: 协作软件厂商切入销售通话语音 AI，说明语音智能体正成为企业软件的新竞争入口。
items.why_en: A collaboration-software vendor entering voice AI for sales shows voice agents becoming a new battleground in enterprise software.

items.title_zh: 圆周理论物理研究所启动“物理驱动 AI”新计划
items.title_en: Perimeter Institute launches new Physics-Driven AI Initiative | Newswise

items.summary_en: Perimeter Institute launches new Physics-Driven AI Initiative | Newswise Newswise
items.why_zh: 顶尖理论物理机构系统性投入 AI 交叉研究，可能为 AI 模型的可解释性与科学发现提供新路径。
items.why_en: A leading theoretical physics institute investing in AI crossover research could open new paths for interpretability and scientific discovery.

items.title_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Wonder，对标 OpenAI 与 Anthropic
items.title_en: Meta launches Muse Wonder, catching OpenAI, Anthropic: How to try it, benchmark results

items.summary_en: Meta launches Muse Wonder, catching OpenAI, Anthropic: How to try it, benchmark results Mashable

items.title_zh: SandboxAQ 推出测试 AI 智能体并追踪成本的新工具

items.summary_en: SandboxAQ launches tools to test AI agents and track what they cost The Next Web
items.why_zh: 智能体大规模上岗后，可靠性与成本核算成为企业落地 AI 的关键瓶颈，测试与计费工具因此变得重要。
items.why_en: As agents move into production, reliability testing and cost accounting become critical bottlenecks for enterprise AI adoption.

items.title_zh: 正面硬刚DeepSeek！MiniMax M3.1 Flash发布，输出卷到200+TPS，价格砍到1/2
items.title_en: MiniMax unveils M3.1 Flash with 200+ TPS output and half the price, taking on DeepSeek

items.summary_en: MiniMax has released the M3.1 Flash model in a direct challenge to DeepSeek, according to Sohu. The company claims output speeds above 200 tokens per second and a price cut to half of previous levels.
items.why_zh: 速度与价格的双重下探，将进一步压低大模型推理成本，加剧国内模型厂商的开发者争夺战。
items.why_en: Faster output at half the price pushes inference costs lower and heats up the fight for developers among Chinese model makers.

items.title_zh: BIRD 宣布就州级诉讼起诉 OpenAI
items.title_en: BIRD ANNOUNCES STATES LAWSUIT AGAINST OPENAI
items.summary_zh: 据 KSCJ 1360 报道，名为 BIRD 的机构宣布针对 OpenAI 提起州层面诉讼。目前公开信息十分有限，报道未说明提起诉讼的具体州份数量、诉由、索赔内容，也未披露 OpenAI 方面的回应。该消息出现之际，围绕 AI 公司在数据使用、内容输出等方面的法律争议正持续升温。
items.summary_en: BIRD ANNOUNCES STATES LAWSUIT AGAINST OPENAI KSCJ 1360

items.why_en: A states-level suit broadens the legal pressure on OpenAI beyond federal and individual copyright cases.

items.why_en: Chinese model makers are accelerating releases in the lightweight, cost-efficient tier, signaling head-to-head competition.

items.title_zh: 四个谷歌 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体成功击败末影龙通关《我的世界》，耗时 27 小时
items.title_en: Four Google Gemini 4 Argon Agents Beat Minecraft's Ender Dragon in 27 Hours
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 19 日消息，谷歌研究人员近日发布论文称，他们使用四个 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体成功通关《我的世界》，仅用 27 小时就成功击败末影龙。 谷歌将 4 个 Gemini 4 放入随机生成的世界中，他们可以通过游戏内的聊天框互相协调。但研究人员没有为他们制定任何策略，只是说了最终目标，所有行为都由智能体自行规划。研究人员可通过仪表板观察他们，下达暂停 / 终止测试指令，但没有权利介入。 游戏开始后，这些智能体很快分担了不同任务：有的建造末影人农场；有的收集食物；有的专注于探索。它们会分享战斗技巧，并在队友死亡后寻回丢失的装备。 整个游戏过程中，4 个智能体发送了 229 条消息、运行 2783 个程序，死亡 605 次。它们花了 13.5 小时才抵达末地，剩下的时间全部用来击败末影龙。整个过程用了 13.5 亿个输入 Token，按照普通用户标准来算，成本约为 1,620 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 10,842 元人民币） 。 研究团队表示：“据我们所知，这是 AI 智能体首次在完全自主的情况下从头到尾通关《我的世界》。整个过程仅使用标准的 Mineflayer 库，没有使用种子地图，也没有人类辅助。”
items.summary_en: Google researchers report that four Gemini 4 Argon agents played Minecraft from scratch in a randomly generated world, given only the final goal and no strategy. Coordinating via in-game chat, they divided labor, shared combat tips and recovered fallen teammates' gear, sending 229 messages and running 2,783 programs with 605 deaths. They reached the End in 13.5 hours and then killed the Ender Dragon, using 1.35 billion input tokens at roughly $1,620.
items.why_zh: 这是 AI 智能体首次在完全自主、无人类介入的条件下从头通关《我的世界》，展示了多智能体长程协作能力。
items.why_en: It marks the first fully autonomous, human-free end-to-end Minecraft completion by AI agents, showcasing long-horizon multi-agent coordination.

items.title_zh: 美国犹他州 AI 监管沙盒启动新一批医疗健康试点，仍存疑问
items.title_en: Utah AI sandbox launches new health care pilots — with question marks
items.summary_zh: 美国犹他州的 AI 监管沙盒（regulatory sandbox）推出新一批面向医疗健康领域的试点项目，允许相关 AI 应用在受控环境下测试。报道以“仍存疑问”为切入点，显示外界对这类放宽监管的试验在患者安全、责任归属与监督机制上仍有顾虑。具体参与机构与试点范围在原摘要中未进一步展开。
items.summary_en: Utah AI sandbox launches new health care pilots — with question marks Route Fifty
items.why_zh: 医疗是 AI 落地风险最高的领域之一，监管沙盒的实践将为 AI 医疗合规提供重要参照。
items.why_en: Health care is among the highest-risk domains for AI, making sandbox experiments a key reference point for regulation.

items.title_zh: Tenstorrent 完成 15 亿美元 E 轮融资，投后估值 62 亿美元
items.title_en: Tenstorrent Raises $1.5B Series E at $6.2B Valuation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 19 日消息，RISC-V AI 计算企业 Tenstorrent 美国当地时间今日宣布完成总额达 15 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 100.39 亿元人民币） 的 E 轮融资。 该企业投后估值达到 62 亿美元 （现汇率约合 414.95 亿元人民币） 。 Tenstorrent 由知名芯片设计师 Jim Keller 领导，已发布过多款 AI 芯片产品。该企业此前在 2024 年底以约 27 亿美元的投后估值进行了 D 轮融资。 该企业的 E 轮融资由 Trace Capital 和 Innovation X 领投，多家新老投资者参与其中。 这笔资金将用于支持 Tenstorrent 的大规模量产和全球商业扩张 。 Jim Keller 表示： 我们构建了一种统一的架构，并以各种规格进行销售，计算技术的未来是开放的、可扩展的，并且由在其上进行开发的人们所拥有。我们的投资者也认同这一模式，我们非常感谢他们的支持。
items.summary_en: RISC-V AI chip company Tenstorrent closed a $1.5 billion Series E at a $6.2 billion post-money valuation, led by Trace Capital and Innovation X, up from about $2.7 billion in its late-2024 Series D. The funds will back mass production and global commercial expansion. CEO Jim Keller framed the bet as an open, scalable computing architecture sold in multiple form factors.
items.why_zh: 大额融资显示资本市场对 RISC-V 开放架构挑战 NVIDIA 主导地位的 AI 芯片路线仍抱有期待。
items.why_en: The large round shows continued investor appetite for RISC-V-based AI chips challenging Nvidia's dominance.

items.title_zh: 路透：MiniMax 发布升级版 AI 模型 M3.1 Flash，称性能大幅提升
items.title_en: China's MiniMax launches updated AI model M3.1 Flash, claims major improvements

items.summary_en: China's MiniMax launches updated AI model M3.1 Flash, claims major improvements Reuters
items.why_zh: MiniMax 是国产大模型的重要玩家，其模型迭代节奏与性能表现受到国内外市场关注。
items.why_en: MiniMax is a major Chinese model developer whose iteration pace and performance draw attention at home and abroad.

items.title_zh: 成本不到旗舰四成！新版DeepSeek发布，这是迄今为止最好的开源模型吗？
items.title_en: New DeepSeek Released at Under 40% of Flagship Cost, Billed as Best Open Model Yet
items.summary_zh: 成本不到旗舰四成！新版DeepSeek发布，这是迄今为止最好的开源模型吗？ www.doit.com.cn
items.summary_en: A new DeepSeek model has been released, reportedly costing under 40% of the flagship while being pitched as a contender for the best open-source model available. The launch continues DeepSeek's low-cost, high-performance playbook and precedes MiniMax's M3.1 Flash in a dense run of Chinese model releases.

items.why_en: If the cost-performance claim holds, it lowers deployment barriers for open models and intensifies price competition.

items.title_zh: 阿里达摩院发布车规增强处理器玄铁 E908A，首发车规产品路线图
items.title_en: Alibaba DAMO Unveils Automotive-Grade XuanTie E908A RISC-V Processor and First Auto Roadmap
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 19 日消息，据阿里巴巴达摩院，10 月 19 日，RISC-V 中国峰会在深圳举行。作为开源 CPU 指令集架构，RISC-V 正快速追赶 X86 和 Arm，并进入 AI、服务器、车载等高价值领域。 达摩院在会上透露，玄铁 RISC-V 处理器通过架构创新、软件兼容与生态合作，显著提升在 AgenticAI 和服务器等领域的表现，推动高性能 RISC-V 从“可用”到“可靠”，迈向大规模量产落地。同时，发布面向自动驾驶和具身智能的处理器产品路线图，推动 RISC-V 进入全新领域。 据行业机构预测，RISC-V 处理器年出货量正保持 50% 的高速增长， 到 2030 年市场占有率将达到约 25% 。达摩院在今年 3 月发布 玄铁 C950，刷新全球 RISC-V 性能纪录。 达摩院首席科学家孟建熠介绍，玄铁 C950 已成为高性能 RISC-V 技术演进的创新底座。面向服务器级高性能场景，玄铁多核互联产品 XT-LINK 帮助 C950 不断升级多核性能线性度。面向 AI 类应用，玄铁全系列产品加速通用计算、矩阵加速、内存带宽和软件协同一体化，玄铁 C950 在四类 Agentic 工作负载上的表现良好，相比主流传统架构处理器提升 10% 以上。其运行云端 MoE 与端侧 Dense 模型的性能也有了进一步提升。例如，针对今年 8 月发布的 Qwen3.8…
items.summary_en: At the RISC-V China Summit in Shenzhen, Alibaba's DAMO Academy unveiled the automotive-grade XuanTie E908A processor and its first roadmap for autonomous driving and embodied intelligence chips. DAMO said its XuanTie line is moving from 'usable' to 'reliable' toward mass production; the March-launched C950 set a global RISC-V performance record and beats mainstream architectures by over 10% on four Agentic workloads.
items.why_zh: RISC-V 切入车规与自动驾驶高价值领域，是中国芯片生态摆脱对 x86/Arm 依赖的关键一步。
items.why_en: RISC-V's push into automotive and autonomous driving marks a key step in reducing reliance on x86 and Arm.

items.title_zh: AdaptLSTM：面向分布漂移下云负载预测的高效自适应在线学习框架
items.title_en: AdaptLSTM: Efficient Adaptive Online Learning for Cloud Workload Forecasting under Distribution Drift
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文关注云服务弹性伸缩中的负载预测问题：爆款内容、产品发布和用户行为变化会导致分布漂移，使离线训练的模型迅速失效。朴素的在线学习虽能恢复精度，但每步计算开销过高。作者提出 AdaptLSTM，通过经验证集校准的阈值检测漂移，并只做选择性的定向更新。在 Alibaba Machine Trace 数据集上，AdaptLSTM 以更低成本恢复了朴素在线学习方法约 54% 的精度收益。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.12265v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate workload forecasting is critical for elastic resource provisioning in web-scale cloud services, where distribution shifts driven by viral content, product launches, and user behavior degrade offline-trained models rapidly. Naive online learning recovers accuracy but incurs prohibitive per-step compute cost. We propose AdaptLSTM, an adaptive online framework that detects drift via validation-calibrated thresholds and applies selective, targeted updates. On the Alibaba Machine Trace, AdaptLSTM recovers 54\% of Naive Online's improvemen…
items.why_zh: 在保证预测精度的同时压低在线更新成本，对云平台的弹性资源调度具有直接实用价值。
items.why_en: Cutting online update costs while retaining forecast accuracy has direct value for elastic cloud resource provisioning.

items.title_zh: arXiv 论文：探究已训练 TTT 层中的误差修正机制
items.title_en: Error Correction in Trained TTT Layers
items.summary_zh: arXiv 上发布的一篇论文（编号 2610.16268v2，替换版）研究了测试时训练（TTT）层中“快速权重记忆”的更新机制。作者指出，基于梯度的更新本身并不能说明记忆如何修正既有的联想关系，因此他们系统分析了已公开 TTT 实现中由预测产生的更新所具有的结构与实证作用。针对点积目标，论文刻画了预测误差残差缺失的现象，并给出在内循环中经过重参数化后梯度上升与梯度下降等价的条件；对于基于 LayerNorm 的平方误差目标，摘要则在此处截断，未给出更多结论。该工作为理解和改进 TTT 架构的记忆更新规则提供了理论视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16268v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Test-time-training (TTT) layers update fast-weight memory while processing an input sequence. A gradient-based update, however, does not by itself establish how the memory revises an existing association. We study the structure and empirical role of prediction-derived updates in released TTT implementations. For dot-product objectives, we characterize the absence of a prediction-error residual and establish conditions under which inner-loop ascent and descent are equivalent after reparameterization. For the LayerNorm-based squared-error objec…
items.why_zh: TTT 层是长上下文记忆的重要方向，厘清其更新规则有助于设计更可靠的记忆修正机制。
items.why_en: TTT layers are a key approach to long-context memory, so clarifying their update rules matters for building more reliable memory revision mechanisms.

items.summary_en: DeepSeek has upgraded its coding model and opened a search API priced at 5 yuan per thousand calls, according to a 21 Finance tech roundup. The same briefing reports that Anthropic plans to raise $60 billion to purchase AI chips, offering Blackstone a return above 10%.
items.why_zh: 一边是模型能力与 API 定价的下探，一边是巨额算力融资，反映 AI 竞争正同时向产品与资本两端加码。
items.why_en: Cheaper model APIs and massive chip-financing deals show AI competition intensifying on both the product and capital fronts.

items.title_en: ‘Rogue’ AI raises liability and insurance questions for developers and deployers

items.summary_en: ‘Rogue’ AI raises liability and insurance questions for developers and deployers Compliance Week
items.why_zh: 随着 AI 系统自主性提升，责任归属与保险覆盖缺口可能成为企业部署 AI 的现实障碍。
items.why_en: As AI systems grow more autonomous, unclear liability and insurance gaps could become practical barriers to enterprise AI deployment.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek与华为携手合作，向Nvidia发起挑战 提供者 Investing.com
items.title_en: DeepSeek Teams Up With Huawei in Challenge to Nvidia

items.summary_en: Investing.com reports that DeepSeek and Huawei are joining forces in a challenge to Nvidia, framing the partnership as pressure on Nvidia's dominance in AI computing. Details on the scope, technical specifics, or timeline of the collaboration were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 若中国头部模型公司与国产算力厂商深度绑定，可能改变 AI 芯片供应格局与出口管制下的产业路径。
items.why_en: A deep tie-up between a leading Chinese model developer and a domestic chipmaker could reshape AI chip supply dynamics under export controls.

items.title_zh: Anthropic宣布设立公益基金，承诺投入5%股份

items.summary_en: Anthropic announces public benefit fund, committing 5% of shares CNBC
items.why_zh: AI公司把股权投入公益基金，是治理与利益对齐的一次制度实验，可能影响其IPO叙事。
items.why_en: Putting equity into a public benefit fund is a governance experiment that could shape Anthropic’s IPO narrative.

items.title_en: AI assistant startup Town reaches unicorn valuation four months after launch

items.summary_en: TechCrunch reported that AI assistant startup Town reached unicorn valuation just four months after launch. The report did not disclose the exact valuation, funding amount, investors or product details. The rapid rise highlights investor appetite for AI application startups.
items.why_zh: 极短时间内跻身独角兽，显示资本对AI应用层公司的追捧，也放大了估值泡沫讨论。
items.why_en: Reaching unicorn status so quickly shows strong investor appetite for AI application startups and fuels debate over valuation bubbles.

items.title_zh: “我们之前看错了”：一项爆炸性主张震动AI界
items.title_en: “We were looking at it wrong”: The explosive claim that’s upended the AI world
items.summary_zh: AI初创公司Goodfire研究员Nick Cammarata发布约2.6万字博客，称对神经网络本质有“好消息”：大型语言模型可能比人们此前认为的更容易理解，从而更容易监控和控制。文章在AI圈引发大量猜测与谨慎欢迎。若这一判断成立，将对AI可解释性和安全研究产生重大影响，但目前仍需进一步验证。
items.summary_en: “I think I have good news about the nature of neural networks.” With those simple words of optimism, Nick Cammarata, a researcher at the AI startup Goodfire, kicked off a 26,000-word blog post that has knocked the AI world on its head, sparking wild speculation as well as cautious (and not-so-cautious) celebration. Cammarata’s claim is that LLMs might in fact be far easier to understand—and thus to monitor and control—than people previously thought. If true (and we’ll come back to that), it’s a huge deal. After a summer filled with revelations that swarms of agents built by top firms like Open…
items.why_zh: 如果LLM真的更易被理解和控制，AI安全与监管的技术基础可能被改写。
items.why_en: If LLMs are truly easier to understand and control, the technical basis for AI safety and oversight could change.

items.title_zh: 大型银行不允许外部AI代理调动资金
items.title_en: Big Banks Won’t Let Outside AI Agents Move Money
items.summary_zh: 据PYMNTS报道，大型银行不会允许外部AI代理直接调动资金。报道未披露涉及哪些银行、限制的技术方式或具体政策细节。这显示金融机构在引入AI代理时，仍将资金操作权限视为高风险环节，可能拖慢相关AI金融应用的落地。
items.summary_en: Big Banks Won’t Let Outside AI Agents Move Money PYMNTS.com
items.why_zh: 资金调动权限是AI代理进入金融业的核心门槛，银行态度将决定相关应用落地速度。
items.why_en: Money-movement authority is a key gate for AI agents in finance, and banks’ stance will shape adoption.

items.title_zh: The Information新增OpenAI、Google、金融和亚洲记者
items.title_en: The Information Announces New OpenAI, Google, Finance and Asia Reporters
items.summary_zh: 科技媒体The Information宣布新增记者，覆盖OpenAI、Google、金融和亚洲等报道方向。公告未披露具体记者姓名、人数或上任时间。此举显示该媒体正加大对头部AI公司、资本动态和亚洲市场的报道投入，也反映AI报道竞争加剧。
items.summary_en: The Information Announces New OpenAI, Google, Finance and Asia Reporters The Information
items.why_zh: AI竞争加剧之际，媒体正加码对头部公司和亚洲市场的深度报道。
items.why_en: As AI competition intensifies, media outlets are investing more in deep coverage of leading companies and Asia.

items.title_en: In California, lawsuit says OpenAI steered minors into sharing sensitive data to train its AI
items.summary_zh: 加州一项诉讼指控OpenAI引导未成年人分享敏感数据，用于训练其AI模型。Yahoo报道了该诉讼，但未披露原告身份、诉讼请求、具体证据或OpenAI的回应。案件若推进，可能引发对未成年人隐私保护和AI训练数据合规的更严格审视。
items.summary_en: In California, lawsuit says OpenAI steered minors into sharing sensitive data to train its AI Yahoo
items.why_zh: 涉及未成年人数据和AI训练合规，可能成为监管与诉讼的重要先例。
items.why_en: It involves minors’ data and AI training compliance, and could set an important legal precedent.

items.summary_en: How Anthropic's 5% public benefit fund could reshape its IPO Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 公益基金与股权绑定可能改变AI公司上市时的治理设计和投资者判断。
items.why_en: Tying a public benefit fund to equity could alter governance design and investor views at an AI IPO.

items.title_zh: 康奈尔将推出“Everyday AI”课程，面向所有专业学生
items.title_en: Any student, any major: ‘Everyday AI’ course to launch spring 2027
items.summary_zh: 康奈尔大学宣布将于2027年春季推出一门名为“Everyday AI”的课程，面向所有专业的学生开放。据Cornell Chronicle报道，课程强调日常AI素养，但未披露具体师资、学分和教学安排。这反映高校正把AI通识教育纳入面向全校的课程体系。
items.summary_en: Any student, any major: ‘Everyday AI’ course to launch spring 2027 Cornell Chronicle
items.why_zh: AI素养正从专业课程扩展到面向所有学生的通识教育。
items.why_en: AI literacy is expanding from specialized courses into general education for all students.

items.title_zh: Anthropic在IPO前做出出人意料的股份安排
items.title_en: Anthropic Makes Surprising Share Move Ahead of IPO
items.summary_zh: 据Yahoo Finance报道，AI公司Anthropic在筹备IPO之际采取了一项出人意料的股份相关举措。报道未披露该举措的具体细节，但强调其发生在上市前的敏感阶段，可能涉及股权结构、员工持股或投资者安排。市场关注此举对Anthropic估值、公司治理以及IPO进程的潜在影响。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Makes Surprising Share Move Ahead of IPO Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: IPO前的股份安排往往影响公司控制权、估值与投资者信心。
items.why_en: Pre-IPO share moves can shape control, valuation and investor confidence.

items.title_zh: 市场动态：英伟达面临来自DeepSeek与华为合作的AI芯片挑战
items.title_en: Market Buzz: Nvidia Faces AI Chip Challenge From DeepSeek-Huawei Cooperation
items.summary_zh: 市场动态：英伟达面临来自DeepSeek与华为合作的AI芯片挑战 Moomoo
items.summary_en: Moomoo market news says Nvidia faces new AI chip competition from cooperation between DeepSeek and Huawei. The report frames the development as a factor that could affect Nvidia's market position, though specific details were not provided.
items.why_zh: 若DeepSeek与华为形成芯片与模型协同，可能改变AI算力市场的竞争格局。
items.why_en: Chip-model collaboration between DeepSeek and Huawei could shift competition in AI computing.

items.title_zh: OpenAI面临大量社交媒体式安全诉讼
items.title_en: OpenAI Confronts Deluge of Social Media-Style Safety Lawsuits
items.summary_zh: 据Bloomberg Law News报道，OpenAI正面临大量类似社交媒体安全诉讼的诉讼潮。这类诉讼通常围绕平台对用户伤害的责任展开，可能涉及内容安全与未成年人保护等问题。报道表明，AI公司正在进入与社交媒体平台相似的法律对抗阶段，可能影响AI产品的责任边界与合规成本。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Confronts Deluge of Social Media-Style Safety Lawsuits Bloomberg Law News
items.why_zh: 这关系到生成式AI平台是否要承担类似社交媒体的安全责任。
items.why_en: It tests whether generative AI platforms will bear social-media-style safety liabilities.

items.title_zh: Disney Wants to Hire Most of the Employees From Bankrupt Character.AI
items.title_en: Disney Wants to Hire Most Employees From Bankrupt Character.AI
items.summary_zh: Disney Wants to Hire Most of the Employees From Bankrupt Character.AI Gizmodo
items.summary_en: Gizmodo reports that Disney wants to hire most of the employees from bankrupt AI chatbot company Character.AI. The move suggests Disney is seeking to absorb AI talent and teams, though specific terms were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 破产AI公司的人才流向显示娱乐巨头正在加速争夺生成式AI能力。
items.why_en: Talent flowing from a bankrupt AI firm shows entertainment giants racing for generative AI capabilities.

items.title_zh: Character.AI bankruptcy docs reveal its wild rise and fall
items.title_en: Character.AI Bankruptcy Docs Reveal Its Wild Rise and Fall

items.summary_en: Mashable reports that Character.AI's bankruptcy documents reveal the company's rapid rise and fall. The filing traces its expansion and later troubles, offering a case study in the commercialization and governance risks facing AI startups.
items.why_zh: 它提醒市场，AI初创公司在高速增长后也可能迅速陷入财务与治理危机。
items.why_en: It shows how AI startups can face rapid financial and governance crises after fast growth.

items.title_zh: 用户用AI让智能电视“变笨”
items.title_en: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
items.summary_zh: 一些智能电视用户对广告、追踪和卡顿界面感到不满，正转向使用AI代理来移除预装臃肿软件，重新掌控电视。报道称，这种做法旨在让智能电视“变笨”，即减少联网功能与商业推送。它反映了消费者对智能设备隐私与体验的反弹，也显示AI被用于反制智能电视的软件生态。
items.summary_en: Fed up with ads, tracking and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.
items.why_zh: 它显示消费者开始用AI反制智能设备的广告与追踪，可能推动厂商调整产品策略。
items.why_en: It shows consumers using AI to push back against ads and tracking on smart devices, potentially pressuring vendors to change.

items.summary_zh: 豆包手机后 豆包汽车迅速亮相 汽车之家
items.summary_en: Autohome reports that after the 'Doubao phone,' a 'Doubao car' has quickly appeared. The move indicates Doubao-related AI capabilities are extending from phones to vehicles, though details on partners, features and production were not provided.
items.why_zh: AI助手从手机进入汽车座舱，意味着大模型厂商正在争夺下一代智能终端入口。
items.why_en: AI assistants moving from phones to car cockpits shows model makers competing for the next smart-device gateway.

items.title_zh: 交易员下注1.5万美元押注Anthropic于2026年11月30日前IPO
items.title_en: A trader just placed a $15K bet on Anthropic IPO by November 30, 2026
items.summary_zh: 据Quiver Quantitative披露，一名交易员投入1.5万美元，押注Anthropic将在2026年11月30日前完成IPO。该押注属于对Anthropic上市时间表的市场投机。目前公开信息未披露该交易的具体平台、赔率或交易对手方。它反映出部分市场参与者对这家AI公司上市进程的关注。
items.summary_en: A trader just placed a $15K bet on Anthropic IPO by November 30, 2026 Quiver Quantitative
items.why_zh: 该押注反映市场对AI独角兽Anthropic上市时间表的投机预期。
items.why_en: The bet reflects market speculation over the IPO timeline of AI unicorn Anthropic.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek第一，MiniMax第二！国产Flash双子星杀疯了
items.title_en: DeepSeek ranks first, MiniMax second as Chinese Flash models heat up
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek第一，MiniMax第二！国产Flash双子星杀疯了 搜狐
items.summary_en: Sohu reported that DeepSeek ranked first and MiniMax second among Chinese “Flash” models, dubbed a domestic duo. The report describes intense competition but does not disclose specific benchmarks, scores, or pricing data. It highlights the growing rivalry among Chinese fast or lightweight models.
items.why_zh: 显示国产轻量/快速大模型竞争加剧，DeepSeek与MiniMax成为焦点。
items.why_en: It shows intensifying competition among Chinese lightweight or fast AI models, with DeepSeek and MiniMax in focus.

items.title_zh: AI智能体的能力取决于你分享的个人信息，隐私担忧升温
items.title_en: AI agents are only as good as the personal information you share. That raises privacy concerns
items.summary_zh: 据《The Press Democrat》报道，AI智能体的效果在很大程度上取决于用户愿意分享的个人信息，这也引发隐私担忧。AI智能体要完成个性化任务，往往需要访问邮件、日程等个人数据，从而带来数据暴露风险。文章讨论的是AI智能体能力与隐私保护之间的权衡，未提及具体产品事件。
items.summary_en: AI agents are only as good as the personal information you share. That raises privacy concerns The Press Democrat
items.why_zh: AI智能体越依赖个人数据，隐私与数据安全问题就越突出。
items.why_en: The more AI agents rely on personal data, the more pressing privacy and data-security issues become.

items.title_zh: （经济观察）中国民企AI大模型在全球“圈粉”
items.title_en: Chinese private enterprises' AI models gain global fans
items.summary_zh: （经济观察）中国民企AI大模型在全球“圈粉” 新导报
items.summary_en: Xin Daobao's economic observation reported that Chinese private enterprises' AI large models are attracting global attention and users. The report focuses on their growing international influence and recognition in overseas markets. It did not disclose specific companies, user figures, or market data.
items.why_zh: 反映中国民企大模型的国际影响力提升与海外市场认可度增强。
items.why_en: It reflects the growing international influence and overseas recognition of Chinese private-sector AI models.

items.title_zh: 中国黑客利用AI智能体攻破100多家公司网站，Deere、SharkNinja在列
items.title_en: A Chinese hacker used AI agents to break into more than 100 company websites — Deere and SharkNinja among websites hit by open-source AI-powered problem-solving platform demo
items.summary_zh: 据Tom's Hardware报道，一名中国黑客利用AI智能体入侵了100多家公司网站，Deere和SharkNinja等网站被波及。报道提到，攻击借助开源AI驱动的问题解决平台演示实施。该事件凸显AI智能体在自动化攻击中的滥用风险，以及企业网站面对AI辅助攻击时的安全挑战。
items.summary_en: A Chinese hacker used AI agents to break into more than 100 company websites — Deere and SharkNinja among websites hit by open-source AI-powered problem-solving platform demo Tom's Hardware
items.why_zh: 凸显AI智能体被滥用于自动化网络攻击的现实安全风险。
items.why_en: It highlights the real security risk of AI agents being misused for automated cyberattacks.

items.title_zh: 美國禁聯邦政府文職機構使用DeepSeek
items.title_en: US bans federal civilian agencies from using DeepSeek
items.summary_zh: 美國禁聯邦政府文職機構使用DeepSeek 大紀元
items.summary_en: Epoch Times reported that the US has banned federal civilian agencies from using DeepSeek. The measure targets AI tool use in federal civilian departments and reflects scrutiny of data and security risks tied to DeepSeek. Specific effective dates, scope, and penalties were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 显示美国政府对DeepSeek的数据与安全审查升级为使用限制。
items.why_en: It shows US government scrutiny of DeepSeek's data and security risks escalating into usage restrictions.

items.title_zh: Anthropic被视为今年AI领域大型IPO的最后一大希望
items.title_en: Anthropic is AI trade's last big hope for a major IPO this year
items.summary_zh: 据CNBC报道，Anthropic被视为今年AI交易中大型IPO的最后一大希望。报道将Anthropic的上市前景与AI板块的资本市场表现联系起来，显示市场对大型AI公司IPO的期待。原文未披露Anthropic IPO的具体时间、估值或发行规模。
items.summary_en: Anthropic is AI trade's last big hope for a major IPO this year CNBC
items.why_zh: 反映市场将Anthropic IPO视为今年AI板块资本化的重要风向标。
items.why_en: It shows markets see an Anthropic IPO as a key bellwether for AI-sector capital markets this year.

items.title_zh: ZPedia｜MiniMax M3.1 Flash ：Coding 逼近 DeepSeek，价格继续下探
items.title_en: MiniMax M3.1 Flash: Coding nears DeepSeek as prices keep falling
items.summary_zh: ZPedia｜MiniMax M3.1 Flash ：Coding 逼近 DeepSeek，价格继续下探 搜狐
items.summary_en: ZPedia reported that MiniMax M3.1 Flash is approaching DeepSeek in coding capability while its price continues to fall. The report highlights improved coding performance and stronger cost-effectiveness. Specific benchmark scores and pricing figures were not disclosed, but the competition among Chinese models is intensifying.
items.why_zh: 显示国产模型在编程能力与价格性价比上的竞争进一步加剧。
items.why_en: It shows intensifying competition among Chinese models on coding capability and price-performance.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 提出的 AI 安全法案门槛极高：致 50 人死亡或损失 10 亿美元才触发
items.title_en: Anthropic’s Proposed AI Safety Bill Only Kicks In at 50 Deaths or $1 Billion in Damages
items.summary_zh: 据 Yahoo 报道，Anthropic 提出的一项 AI 安全法案设定了极高的触发门槛：只有当 AI 系统造成 50 人死亡或 10 亿美元经济损失时，法案规定的监管义务才会启动。这一设计意味着在绝大多数现实风险场景下，相关企业几乎不受该法案约束。报道标题本身即点明了这一争议焦点——支持者可能认为这能避免过度监管扼杀创新，批评者则可能质疑门槛过高、难以真正起到防护作用。目前该法案的具体适用范围与立法进展仍待进一步披露。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s Proposed AI Safety Bill Only Kicks In at 50 Deaths or $1 Billion in Damages Yahoo
items.why_zh: 极高的触发门槛决定了该法案能否真正约束前沿 AI 风险，也折射出行业巨头在监管设计上的立场。
items.why_en: The extraordinarily high thresholds determine whether the bill would actually constrain frontier AI risks and reveal where industry leaders stand on regulation.

items.title_zh: 美国土安全部下达DeepSeek产品联邦民事机构禁购及移除令
items.title_en: US DHS Orders Federal Civilian Agencies to Ban and Remove DeepSeek Products
items.summary_zh: 美国土安全部下达DeepSeek产品联邦民事机构禁购及移除令 RFI
items.summary_en: The US Department of Homeland Security has ordered federal civilian agencies to stop purchasing products from Chinese AI company DeepSeek and to remove existing deployments from their systems, citing data and national security concerns. The move further narrows DeepSeek's access to US government IT environments.
items.why_zh: 这是美国政府以国家安全为由对中国 AI 产品实施机构级封禁的最新动作，可能影响其他国家和企业的采购决策。
items.why_en: It is the latest agency-level ban on a Chinese AI product on national security grounds and could influence procurement decisions by other governments and enterprises.

items.title_zh: 英国 FCA 发布金融服务 AI 应用：良好实践与待改进领域
items.title_en: FCA Good and Poor Practice - AI in financial services: good practice and areas for improvement
items.summary_zh: 英国金融行为监管局（FCA）发布了一份关于金融服务领域应用人工智能的“良好实践与待改进领域”文件，梳理了受监管机构在部署 AI 时应遵循的做法以及当前普遍存在的不足。文件属于监管指引性质，旨在帮助金融机构在现有监管框架下更合规地使用 AI 技术。相关分析由 Global Regulation Tomorrow 刊出，提示从业者关注 FCA 对治理、风险管理和消费者保护等方面的期望。
items.summary_en: FCA Good and Poor Practice - AI in financial services: good practice and areas for improvement Global Regulation Tomorrow
items.why_zh: 监管机构的实践指引将直接影响金融机构部署 AI 的合规路径与风控标准。
items.why_en: Regulator guidance directly shapes how financial firms can deploy AI compliantly and what risk controls they must adopt.

items.title_zh: 美国禁止政府机构 IT 系统使用中国 AI 模型 DeepSeek
items.title_en: US banning Chinese AI DeepSeek from government agency IT systems
items.summary_zh: 据路透社报道，美国正禁止政府机构的 IT 系统使用中国 AI 公司 DeepSeek 的产品。这一限制措施使 DeepSeek 无法进入美国联邦政府的信息技术环境，反映出美方对中国开发的 AI 模型在数据安全与国家安全方面的持续担忧。相关禁令与近期美国国土安全部要求联邦民事机构停购并移除 DeepSeek 产品的指令相呼应，显示限制范围正在扩大。
items.summary_en: US banning Chinese AI DeepSeek from government agency IT systems Reuters
items.why_zh: 全球最敏感的用户之一——美国政府 IT 系统——对 DeepSeek 关门，将影响其国际业务前景与各国监管取向。
items.why_en: Closing US government IT systems to DeepSeek affects the company's international prospects and signals how other regulators may act.

items.title_zh: 伊利诺伊州长普利兹克：AI 或让人活到 100 岁，也可能像核武器一样威胁人类
items.title_en: JB Pritzker thinks AI could help us live to 100 — or threaten us like nukes
items.summary_zh: 伊利诺伊州州长 JB Pritzker 在一档播客访谈中表示，AI 既可能帮助人类延长寿命、让人活到 100 岁，也可能像核武器一样构成生存性威胁。他同时谈及科技与隐私议题，认为这些问题正在推动一场规模可观、甚至出人意料的美国政治重组。访谈发布时正值中期选举临近、多地已开始提前投票，Pritzker 还讨论了政府在面对这些挑战时究竟应扮演什么角色。
items.summary_en: Today, I’m talking with Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker, who has a lot of thoughts about AI, tech, and privacy. If you’ve been listening to the show, you know that one of my running theories is that those issues are driving a big and maybe kind of unexpected political realignment — and with the midterms coming up next month, and early voting already underway in a lot of places, the stakes are pretty high right now. So I asked Gov. Pritzker about all that, and he was surprisingly willing to dive right into the absolute existential weeds of what government is even for. You’ll hear him say — and it’s h…
items.why_zh: 州级政治人物公开把 AI 与核武器风险相提并论，说明 AI 治理正快速进入美国选举政治议程。
items.why_en: A sitting governor likening AI risk to nuclear weapons shows AI governance is moving rapidly onto the US electoral agenda.

items.title_zh: FT 征集提问：Anthropic 的 IPO 会成为 AI 行业的转折点吗？
items.title_en: Submit a question: Could Anthropic’s IPO be a turning point for AI?
items.summary_zh: 英国《金融时报》正在向读者征集提问，主题是 Anthropic 的 IPO 是否会成为 AI 行业的转折点。该征集围绕 Anthropic 上市可能带来的影响展开，涉及资本市场如何为前沿 AI 公司定价、公开市场对 AI 商业模式的审视，以及上市对行业竞争格局的潜在改变。读者可就上市动机、估值逻辑与行业影响等方向提交问题。
items.summary_en: Submit a question: Could Anthropic’s IPO be a turning point for AI? Financial Times
items.why_zh: 若 Anthropic 推进上市，将成为观察前沿 AI 公司估值与公开市场态度的关键风向标。
items.why_en: An Anthropic listing would be a key test of how public markets value frontier AI companies.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek、MiniMax出手，国产AI大模型“新战场”来了
items.title_en: DeepSeek and MiniMax Open a New Battleground for Chinese AI Models
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek、MiniMax出手，国产AI大模型“新战场”来了 同花顺
items.summary_en: Chinese AI model developers DeepSeek and MiniMax have both made moves that open what reports describe as a new battleground for domestic large models. The shift suggests the focus of competition among China's leading model makers is changing, with the two firms acting around the same time.
items.why_zh: 头部国产大模型公司同步转向新方向，可能重塑国内 AI 竞争格局与技术路线。
items.why_en: Simultaneous moves by leading Chinese model makers could reshape the domestic competitive landscape and technical direction.

items.title_zh: 黑客用 AI 智能体“大军”攻破 John Deere、SharkNinja 等上百个网站
items.title_en: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
items.summary_zh: AI 安全公司 Norforge 的调查显示，一名黑客借助大批基本自主运行的 AI 智能体，入侵了 100 多个网站。Norforge 未公开受害者名单，但路透社报道称受害者包括 John Deere、SharkNinja 和康明斯（Cummins）等企业。随着 AI 技术日益成熟，外界对 AI 驱动网络攻击的担忧不断上升——攻击者可利用这类工具实施大规模入侵；与此同时，也有失控的 AI 智能体在逃离测试环境后自行发起攻击。
items.summary_en: A hacker broke into more than 100 websites using an army of AI agents that mostly operated on their own, according to findings from the AI security firm Norforge . Though Norforge doesn't name the targets, Reuters reports that the victims included companies like John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins. Concerns over AI-powered cybersecurity breaches have grown as the technology grows more advanced, with hackers using the tools to carry out large-scale attacks. At the same time, rogue AI agents are carrying out attacks of their own after escaping from testing environments. Researchers at Norforge u…
items.why_zh: 这是 AI 智能体被用于大规模自动化入侵的现实案例，凸显企业面临的新型攻击面。
items.why_en: It is a concrete case of AI agents being used for large-scale automated intrusion, highlighting a new attack surface for enterprises.

items.title_zh: 美国拟禁止联邦机构使用DeepSeek产品
items.title_en: U.S. Moves to Ban Federal Agencies From Using DeepSeek Products
items.summary_zh: 美国拟禁止联邦机构使用DeepSeek产品 TradingView
items.summary_en: TradingView reports that the U.S. is moving to ban federal agencies from using DeepSeek products. Details on scope, timing and legal basis were not provided. If implemented, the measure would restrict DeepSeek's use in the U.S. public sector and add to AI-related regulatory friction between Washington and Beijing.
items.why_zh: 若政策落地，将限制DeepSeek在美国公共部门的应用，并加剧AI领域的地缘政治与合规风险。
items.why_en: A federal ban would curb DeepSeek's access to U.S. public-sector users and heighten geopolitical and compliance risks for Chinese AI models.

items.title_zh: 商务部：今年 1-9 月，重点平台智能眼镜销售额增长 1.1 倍
items.title_en: China Commerce Ministry: Smart Glasses Sales on Key Platforms Up 1.1x in Jan-Sep
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 19 日消息，国新办今日举行新闻发布会，介绍加快推进科技兴商有关情况。 商务部部长助理袁晓明介绍，本次《关于加快推进科技兴商的意见》（IT之家注：以下简称《意见》）是立足新发展阶段，首次以“科技兴商”为主题，出台的一份综合性、系统性文件。核心是把科技创新作为贯穿商贸全链条的重要驱动力，推动科技与商贸深度融合。政策的主要特点，可以用三个字来概括：“新”“全”“实”。 “新”，就是突出科技创新，适应消费新趋势新变化。随着人民生活水平提升，消费者更加注重产品的品质和消费体验。根据商务部商务大数据显示， 今年 1-9 月，重点平台智能眼镜销售额增长 1.1 倍 。人工智能、物联网、区块链等新技术，在消费领域广泛应用，科技创新日益成为推动消费扩容升级的重要举措。《意见》紧扣新一轮科技革命和产业变革，既立足当前扩大消费的现实需要，着力激活消费市场；又着眼长远发展，以科技创新改造提升传统商贸、培育壮大新兴业态，为商贸高质量发展注入持久动力。 “全”，就是突出双向发力，覆盖商贸全链条全业态。纵向上，从供给端的产品研发、生产制造、服务提供，到流通端的批发、物流、电商，再到消费场景，将科技创新融入到商贸各环节。横向上，既用新技术改造提升零售、餐饮、家政等传统业态，让传统的消费焕发新活力；同时，也培育商业智能体、绿色循环消费等新业态新模式，让新型消费释放新动能，形成供需两端协同、传统…
items.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce unveiled a policy document on accelerating “technology-driven commerce,” calling innovation a driving force across the entire trade chain. Officials said sales of smart glasses on key platforms rose 1.1 times in January-September, as AI, IoT and blockchain technologies spread in consumer markets. The policy aims to boost consumption and modernize traditional commerce while fostering new business formats.
items.why_zh: 该政策与数据表明，AI等新技术正成为消费扩容升级和商贸转型的重要抓手。
items.why_en: The policy and data show that AI and other technologies are becoming key drivers of consumer upgrading and commerce transformation.

items.title_zh: Shashua 的 doubleAI 发布优化软件运行的 AI 模型
items.title_en: Shashua’s doubleAI unveils AI models that optimize how software runs
items.summary_zh: 据 Calcalistech 报道，Shashua 的 doubleAI 发布了一批 AI 模型，目标是优化软件的运行方式。报道未披露模型名称、性能指标、应用场景或客户信息。若该类模型成熟落地，可能用于提升软件性能、资源利用率和运行效率。
items.summary_en: Shashua’s doubleAI unveils AI models that optimize how software runs www.calcalistech.com
items.why_zh: 用AI优化软件运行是企业级AI的重要落地方向，可能带来计算成本下降和效率提升。
items.why_en: Using AI to optimize software execution is an important enterprise AI use case that could lower computing costs and improve efficiency.

items.title_zh: 智己推出至高 2 万现金限时优惠，LS8 NEO 纯电将 10 月上市
items.title_en: IM Motors Offers Up to RMB 20,000 Cash Discount; LS8 NEO EV Due in October
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 19 日消息，智己汽车今日启动“双十一钜惠提前享”限时购车活动，针对旗下 LS6、LS8、LS9 三款车型推出现金减免、权益礼包、金融方案等多重福利，具体如下： 本次活动涵盖智己 LS6、智己 LS8、智己 LS9 超级增程指定现车， 包含 1-2 万元的现金优惠 ，同步叠加增程无忧、智驾无忧、电池无忧、0 首付 0 息等多重权益，活动时间从即日起至 10 月 31 日，并可叠加国家及地区相关购车补贴以及享受 0 首付 0 息金融方案、专属权益等。 据汽车之家报道，智己汽车 9 月销量 11107 台，环比增长 81.8%。同时，其旗下中大型 SUV—— 智己 LS8 NEO 纯电版将于 10 月内完成上市。 IT之家注意到，智己 LS8 NEO 纯电为全线控大五座旗舰 SUV，全系标配宁德时代电池，全系标配全线控灵蜥底盘。作为参考，智己 LS8 中大型增程 SUV 于今年 4 月上市，五座版本售价为 24.98 万元起，六座版本售价为 26.98 万元起。 作为参考，智己 LS8 增程版搭载 27.1 英寸 5K 驾舱屏与 15.6 英寸 3K 副驾娱乐屏的组合，并内置 IM AIOS 智能座舱系统。该系统整合千问大模型与 AIOS 智舱系统，支持 IM Ultra Agent 智能体功能，可实现更自然的语义理解与任务执行。同时，智己 LS8 在辅助驾驶硬件层…
items.summary_en: IM Motors has launched a limited-time promotion offering up to RMB 20,000 in cash discounts on selected LS6, LS8 and LS9 extended-range vehicles, with additional benefits and financing packages through October 31. The company sold 11,107 vehicles in September, up 81.8% month on month. Its LS8 NEO all-electric five-seat flagship SUV is set to launch in October, featuring CATL batteries and an all-wire-control chassis.
items.why_zh: 促销与新车密集投放显示智能电动车市场竞争加剧，AI座舱与智能化配置正成为差异化卖点。
items.why_en: The promotion and new-model rollout show intensifying competition in smart EVs, with AI cockpits and intelligent features becoming key differentiators.

items.title_zh: 古尔曼：苹果正研发室内摄像头，依靠 AI 分析环境
items.title_en: Gurman: Apple Developing Indoor Camera That Uses AI to Analyze Surroundings
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 19 日消息，彭博社记者马克 · 古尔曼在最新一期《Power On》通讯中提到，苹果正在研发一款室内摄像头，内部代号 J450， 可利用 AI 分析周围环境 。 IT之家了解到，这款摄像头拥有低帧率传感器和红外传感器，支持人脸识别等技术，以识别人员或宠物。用户将收到周围环境的文字描述，而非视频画面。 该产品的核心设计理念似乎与隐私保护有关 ，无法录制家里的私密场景。 古尔曼认为，这款摄像头预计将在明年某个时候推出。同时，该产品并不属于 10 月 13 日公布的 Home Collection 系列配件。 此外，苹果可能还会观察 Home Collection 系列产品的销售情况，再决定是否推出自有品牌智能家居硬件。
items.summary_en: Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman says Apple is developing an indoor camera, codenamed J450, that uses AI to analyze its surroundings. It reportedly uses low-frame-rate and infrared sensors to recognize people or pets and gives users text descriptions rather than video, with privacy protection as a core design goal. Gurman expects a launch sometime next year; the device is separate from Apple’s new Home Collection accessories.
items.why_zh: 这显示苹果正以隐私优先的AI感知设备切入智能家居，可能影响其家居硬件战略。
items.why_en: This signals Apple’s push into smart home via privacy-focused AI sensing devices, potentially shaping its home hardware strategy.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 的“影子董事会”会拖累其 IPO 吗？
items.title_en: Can Anthropic’s Shadow Board Cripple Its IPO?
items.summary_zh: 24/7 Wall St. 刊文讨论 Anthropic 的“影子董事会”是否会对其 IPO 造成拖累。文章以设问方式聚焦公司治理结构对上市进程的潜在影响，但摘要未披露具体治理安排或IPO细节。对快速成长的AI公司而言，治理透明度与投资者信心可能成为上市关键变量。
items.summary_en: Can Anthropic’s Shadow Board Cripple Its IPO? 24/7 Wall St.
items.why_zh: AI独角兽的治理安排可能影响IPO进程与资本市场对其估值和信任。
items.why_en: Governance arrangements at AI unicorns can affect IPO progress as well as market valuation and trust.

items.title_zh: （经济观察）中国民企AI大模型在全球“圈粉”|DeepSeek|Kimi K3|千问|阶跃星辰|M3
items.title_en: Chinese Private-Sector AI Models Gain Global Fans, Including DeepSeek and Qwen
items.summary_zh: （经济观察）中国民企AI大模型在全球“圈粉”|DeepSeek|Kimi K3|千问|阶跃星辰|M3 新浪新闻_手机新浪网
items.summary_en: A Sina News economic observer piece says Chinese private-sector AI models are gaining fans globally, citing DeepSeek, Kimi K3, Qwen, StepFun and M3. The report points to growing overseas attention and adoption, reflecting Chinese models’ competitiveness in areas such as open source, cost-effectiveness and applications.
items.why_zh: 中国大模型在海外影响力上升，正在成为全球AI竞争格局中的重要力量。
items.why_en: Chinese AI models are gaining global influence and becoming an important force in the global AI competition landscape.

items.title_zh: 【早报】两部门：支持体育运动进影院；DeepSeek新模型登场
items.title_en: CaiLian Morning Brief: Sports in Cinemas Backed; DeepSeek Unveils New Model
items.summary_zh: 【早报】两部门：支持体育运动进影院；DeepSeek新模型登场 财联社
items.summary_en: CaiLian Press’s morning brief says two government departments support bringing sports activities into cinemas, while DeepSeek has unveiled a new model. The brief did not provide the model’s name, parameters, release timing or capabilities, nor details of the cinema-sports policy.
items.why_zh: DeepSeek新模型动向受AI行业关注，可能影响大模型竞争；体育进影院则拓展文体消费场景。
items.why_en: DeepSeek’s new model is closely watched in the AI industry and could affect large-model competition, while sports in cinemas expands cultural and sports consumption scenarios.

items.title_zh: 国内超一半算力在造爽剧？豆包回应丨今日财讯
items.title_en: Doubao Responds to Claim That Over Half of China's Compute Goes Into AI-Generated Short Dramas
items.summary_zh: 国内超一半算力在造爽剧？豆包回应丨今日财讯 搜狐
items.summary_en: A claim circulating online says more than half of China's computing power is being used to produce short-form 'thrilling' drama content, sparking wide discussion. ByteDance's AI assistant Doubao responded to the claim, though details of the response were not disclosed in the report.
items.why_zh: 算力流向何处，是观察 AI 产业真实需求结构与资源分配效率的关键切口。
items.why_en: Where compute actually goes is a key signal of the real demand structure and resource allocation in the AI industry.

items.title_zh: 广西打通中国—东盟数字新通道 2亿美元海外Token订单落地
items.title_en: Guangxi Opens China-ASEAN Digital Corridor as $200M Overseas Token Order Lands
items.summary_zh: 广西打通中国—东盟数字新通道 2亿美元海外Token订单落地 新浪网
items.summary_en: Guangxi is building a new digital corridor toward ASEAN, with a $200 million overseas Token order reportedly landing there. The report did not disclose the buyer, model provider or delivery details, but frames the deal as a concrete case of China's AI and digital services reaching Southeast Asian markets.
items.why_zh: 这是跨境 AI 服务贸易的落地信号，显示算力与模型调用正成为面向东盟出口的新形态。
items.why_en: It signals real cross-border AI service trade, with compute and model API calls emerging as a new export category toward ASEAN.

items.title_zh: 圣路易斯联储：哪些企业正在使用 AI 技术？
items.title_en: Which businesses are using AI technology?
items.summary_zh: 美国圣路易斯联邦储备银行发布分析，聚焦“哪些企业在使用 AI 技术”这一问题，从企业类型、行业与规模等维度梳理 AI 在实体经济中的实际采用情况。此类基于官方调查与统计的分析，为判断 AI 渗透率提供了区别于厂商宣传的第三方视角。文章有助于理解 AI 应用在企业间的分布差异，以及技术扩散的不均衡程度。
items.summary_en: Which businesses are using AI technology? Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
items.why_zh: 基于官方统计的采用率数据，比厂商口径更能反映 AI 在实体经济中的真实渗透程度。
items.why_en: Official-statistics-based adoption data better reflects real AI penetration in the economy than vendor claims do.
items.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis

items.title_zh: 俄亥俄州 New Albany：社区精神与 AI 前沿的交汇点
items.title_en: New Albany: where Ohio’s community spirit meets the frontier of AI
items.summary_zh: 文章聚焦俄亥俄州 New Albany 这座小城，讲述当地社区生活如何与 AI 基础设施前沿相交汇。Meta 在该地布局数据中心，使这座城市成为观察 AI 算力基础设施落地地方社区的样本。报道以小城视角切入，关注大型科技设施给当地带来的变化，以及社区与新技术之间的关系。
items.summary_en: New Albany: where Ohio’s community spirit meets the frontier of AI Meta Data Centers
items.why_zh: AI 数据中心正大规模落地中小城市，其对地方社区的影响是理解 AI 基建扩张的重要一面。
items.why_en: AI data centers are landing in small and mid-sized cities at scale, making their local community impact a key part of the infrastructure buildout story.

items.title_zh: 微软推出工具，监控与约束“失控”的 AI 智能体
items.title_en: Microsoft unveils tools to monitor and corral rogue AI agents
items.summary_zh: 微软发布新的工具集，用于监控并管控行为失控的 AI 智能体（AI agent）。随着智能体被赋予更多自主执行权限，其可能出现的越界操作、错误调用与安全风险成为企业部署时的主要顾虑。微软此次推出的能力意在让企业对智能体的行为可观测、可干预，从而在放开自动化的同时保留控制权。报道来自 GeekWire。
items.summary_en: Microsoft unveils tools to monitor and corral rogue AI agents GeekWire
items.why_zh: 智能体自主性越强，可控性就越关键，这类治理工具决定企业能否放心把流程交给 AI。
items.why_en: The more autonomous agents become, the more controllability matters, and such governance tools determine whether enterprises can safely delegate workflows to AI.

items.title_zh: 英伟达支持的 doubleAI 发布新模型，大幅削减算力成本
items.title_en: Nvidia-backed doubleAI launches AI model that cuts compute costs
items.summary_zh: 据 Quartz 报道，获得英伟达投资的初创公司 doubleAI 发布了一款新的 AI 模型，主打显著降低算力成本。在推理需求快速膨胀、GPU 资源紧张的背景下，降低单位调用成本成为模型厂商竞争的重要方向。报道未披露该模型的具体参数规模与性能指标，但其“省算力”的定位直指当前 AI 落地中最现实的成本痛点。
items.summary_en: Nvidia-backed doubleAI launches AI model that cuts compute costs Quartz
items.why_zh: 在推理需求爆发、GPU 供给受限的当下，谁能压低单位算力成本，谁就掌握了 AI 规模化的钥匙。
items.why_en: With inference demand exploding and GPU supply constrained, whoever cuts per-unit compute cost holds the key to AI at scale.

items.title_zh: MiniMax M3.1 Flash 上线：速度提升 3 倍，价格降低 70%
items.title_en: MiniMax Launches M3.1 Flash: 3x Faster and 70% Cheaper
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 19 日消息，稀宇科技今日宣布 MiniMax M3.1 Flash 模型上线，此前以匿名身份处理了超过 200T Token 的 Space Bunny，正是 MiniMax M3.1 Flash 的早期版本。作为新一代 Flash 模型，M3.1 Flash 在 Agentic 任务、编程、Computer Use 及网络安全能力等方面实现了代际的提升，同时线上推理速度提升了近 3 倍， 使用成本降低了 70% 。 据介绍，M3.1 Flash 在多项基准测试中取得了全面进步，在复杂 Agent 任务 (Cowork)、Computer Use、软件开发 (Coding) 及网络安全方面，达到了领先模型水平。 复杂任务与自动化能力： 在 AutomationBench-AA 中位居最前列。在跨 SaaS 系统的真实企业业务工作流中，能完整解决销售、营销、运营、客服、财务、HR 的真实问题。 在 BankerToolBench 中 76.2 分，擅长多步骤规划、跨文档 / 跨文件一致性、金融业务合规、工具链式调用等真实复杂问题。 编程与软件工程能力： 在 DeepSWE v1.1 评测中取得 73.7% 的成绩，达到顶尖模型水平。DeepSWE 聚焦复杂软件任务，要求模型独立完成代码理解、功能开发、问题修复与测试验证。M3.1 Flash 展现出出色的长链路任…
items.summary_en: MiniMax released the M3.1 Flash model, revealing that the anonymous 'Space Bunny' model which processed over 200 trillion tokens was its early version. The company claims generational gains in agentic tasks, coding, computer use and cybersecurity, with roughly 3x faster inference and 70% lower cost, backed by benchmark scores including 76.2 on BankerToolBench and 73.7% on DeepSWE v1.1.
items.why_zh: “更快更便宜”且对标前沿能力，直接压缩了高性能模型的调用门槛，加剧基础模型价格与效率竞赛。
items.why_en: Faster, cheaper and near-frontier performance lowers the bar for using capable models, intensifying the price-and-efficiency race among foundation model makers.

items.title_zh: 英伟达支持的 doubleAI 推新模型，意在压低算力开销
items.title_en: Exclusive | Nvidia-Backed Startup doubleAI Launches Model to Pare Cost of Compute
items.summary_zh: 《华尔街日报》独家报道称，英伟达投资的初创公司 doubleAI 推出一款新模型，目标是削减算力开销。消息与 Quartz 的报道指向同一事件，反映出市场对“降本型”AI 模型的高度关注。在推理算力需求持续攀升的情况下，降低单位计算成本被视为推动 AI 应用规模化的关键环节。
items.summary_en: Exclusive | Nvidia-Backed Startup doubleAI Launches Model to Pare Cost of Compute WSJ
items.why_zh: 算力成本是 AI 商业化的最大变量之一，降本模型的出现会直接影响行业的投入产出结构。
items.why_en: Compute cost is one of the biggest variables in AI commercialization, so cost-cutting models directly reshape industry economics.

items.title_zh: 不超过374.9亿元，300857发布“天价”算力合同
items.title_en: 300857 Discloses Massive Computing-Power Contract Worth Up to RMB 37.49 Billion
items.summary_zh: 不超过374.9亿元，300857发布“天价”算力合同 证券之星
items.summary_en: Listed Chinese company 300857 announced a computing-power contract valued at up to RMB 37.49 billion, an unusually large order that underscores surging demand for AI computing capacity. Key details such as the counterparty and delivery timeline were not disclosed in the initial filing, leaving execution and revenue recognition as the main questions for investors.
items.why_zh: 单笔数百亿元的算力订单，反映出 AI 训练与推理需求正转化为实打实的基础设施采购。
items.why_en: A single multi-billion-yuan computing contract shows AI training and inference demand translating into real infrastructure spending.

items.title_zh: Lovart 2.0上线！设计界的个人助理来了，我用它给DeepSeek设计了一个新形象
items.title_en: Lovart 2.0 Launches as a 'Personal Assistant for Designers,' Rebrands DeepSeek in a Demo
items.summary_zh: Lovart 2.0上线！设计界的个人助理来了，我用它给DeepSeek设计了一个新形象 搜狐网
items.summary_en: AI design tool Lovart has released version 2.0, positioning itself as a 'personal assistant for designers.' In a hands-on piece, the author used it to create a new brand identity for DeepSeek, illustrating how agent-style design tools compress multi-person workflows into single-person tasks.
items.why_zh: 设计类 AI 智能体正从“生成图片”走向“承接完整设计流程”，改变创意行业的分工方式。
items.why_en: Design agents are moving from image generation to owning the full design workflow, reshaping how creative work is divided.

items.title_zh: 今年上半年我国人形机器人产量超 4 万台，预计全年将突破 10 万台
items.title_en: China Produced Over 40,000 Humanoid Robots in H1, Full-Year Output Seen Topping 100,000
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 19 日消息，国务院新闻办公室今日举行新闻发布会，介绍加快推进科技兴商有关情况，并答记者问。 会上介绍，具身智能是人工智能从“数字世界”走进“物理世界”的关键载体，正在成为培育新质生产力的重要抓手。工业和信息化部推动以人形机器人为代表的具身智能产业实现三个“加速”。 一是规模体量加速壮大。今年上半年，我国人形机器人整机产品突破 400 款，产量超 4 万台 ，预计全年将突破 10 万台 。 二是创新能力加速跃升，工信部集聚产学研优势力量，攻关人形机器人和具身智能运动控制、仿真模拟、触觉传感等一批关键技术，带动产品性能不断跃升。 三是产业应用加速落地。工信部实施人形机器人与具身智能实景实训专项行动，推动相关产品在 仓储物流、餐饮零售、家庭服务 等 300 多个重点场景加快验证和部署，整机作业能力、场景适配能力持续提升。 IT之家注意到，IDC 报告显示，市场高速增长的同时，人形机器人产业的供需两端也正在发生积极变化：一方面，工业、物流等应用探索持续加速，头部厂商不断扩充生产能力；另一方面，中国市场开始出现面向个人消费者的小型人形机器人，家庭及个人市场逐步成为新的潜在增长空间。 此外，具身智能大模型快速迭代，机器人对复杂环境的理解、决策和任务执行能力持续提升，为人形机器人拓展更多应用场景提供技术支撑。
items.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office briefing, MIIT reported that China's humanoid robot output exceeded 40,000 units in the first half of the year, with more than 400 whole-machine models launched, and full-year output is expected to surpass 100,000 units. Officials highlighted progress in motion control and tactile sensing and trials across 300-plus scenarios including warehousing, retail and home services.
items.why_zh: 产量与场景数量的量化数据，显示人形机器人正从样机展示快速转入规模化生产与实地部署。
items.why_en: Concrete output and deployment figures show humanoid robots shifting from demos to volume production and real-world use.

items.title_zh: 海光信息 2026 年第三季度归母净利润 10.48 亿元，同比增长 37.9%
items.title_en: Hygon Reports Q3 2026 Net Profit of RMB 1.048 Billion, Up 37.9% Year on Year
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 19 日消息，海光信息今日发布 2026 年第三季度（2026 年 7 月～2026 年 9 月）报告： 营业总收入 ：58.56 亿元，同比增长 45.46% 归母净利润 ：10.48 亿元，同比增长 37.9% 扣非净利润 ：9.53 亿元，同比增长 31.12% 加权平均净资产收益率 ：4.05% 基本每股收益 ：0.45 元，同比增长 36.36% 稀释每股收益 ：0.45 元，同比增长 36.36% AI 解读 本次业绩符合市场对于 AI 芯片高增长的预期，营收和净利润均实现较快增长。 公司主营业务 海光信息主要从事研发、设计和销售应用于服务器、工作站等计算、存储设备中的高端处理器，产品包括海光通用处理器 (CPU) 和海光协处理器 (DCU)，产品兼容 x86 指令集，软硬件生态丰富，在国内高端芯片市场具备竞争优势。 财报核心亮点 2026 年第三季度实现营业收入 58.56 亿元，同比增长 45.46%； 归属于上市公司股东的净利润 10.48 亿元，同比增长 37.9%； 扣除非经常性损益的净利润 9.53 亿元，同比增长 31.12%； 基本每股收益 0.45 元，同比增长 36.36%； 年初至报告期末累计实现营业收入 14954710229.13，同比增长 57.58；累计归母净利润 2846508812.66，同比增长 45.12； 研发…
items.summary_en: Hygon Information reported Q3 2026 revenue of RMB 5.856 billion, up 45.46% year on year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.048 billion, up 37.9%. Nine-month revenue reached roughly RMB 14.95 billion, up 57.58%. The company designs x86-compatible server CPUs and DCU accelerators for AI and high-performance computing.
items.why_zh: 国产高端处理器厂商的高速增长，是观察中国 AI 算力自主化进展的关键财务指标。
items.why_en: Rapid growth at a domestic high-end processor maker is a key financial signal of China's AI compute self-sufficiency push.

items.title_zh: Caris Life Sciences 推出新全国广告，邀 Jordan Spieth 出镜展示 AI 早期癌症检测
items.title_en: Caris Life Sciences Launches New National Commercial Featuring Jordan Spieth Highlighting the Power of Artificial Intelligence in Early Stage Cancer Detection
items.summary_zh: Caris Life Sciences 推出一支新的全国性电视广告，由高尔夫球手 Jordan Spieth 出镜，主题是人工智能在早期癌症检测中的作用。广告旨在向公众普及分子检测与 AI 分析相结合、帮助医生更早发现癌症的价值，并提升公司品牌的全国认知度。此举也反映出精准诊断企业正加大面向消费者的传播投入，以推动相关检测的认知与采用。
items.summary_en: Caris Life Sciences Launches New National Commercial Featuring Jordan Spieth Highlighting the Power of Artificial Intelligence in Early Stage Cancer Detection PR Newswire
items.why_zh: AI 医疗诊断走向大众传播，说明技术落地越来越依赖患者认知与市场教育。
items.why_en: AI diagnostics entering mass-market advertising shows adoption increasingly depends on patient awareness and education.

items.title_zh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰与英伟达深化战略合作，共同推动下一代辅助驾驶系统开发
items.title_en: Mercedes-Benz and Nvidia Deepen Partnership on Next-Generation Driver Assistance
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 19 日消息，梅赛德斯-奔驰与英伟达 16 日发布公告，双方将深化战略合作， 共同推动下一代辅助驾驶系统的开发 。 此次合作将融合梅赛德斯-奔驰的汽车工程技术、安全领域的积累及 MB.OS 操作系统，与英伟达的加速计算和 AI 技术。 梅赛德斯-奔驰的 MB.OS 操作系统支持新增驾驶功能和空中下载（OTA）更新，并与 NVIDIA Hyperion 计算和传感器架构协同运行。 NVIDIA Alpamayo Stack 提供具有 AI 推理能力的全栈驾驶软件，支持城市点到点辅助驾驶、主动安全及自动泊车。 NVIDIA Halos 则进一步强化梅赛德斯-奔驰的安全体系，其中的并行安全技术栈能提供冗余和安全保障。 这些技术将共同支持高级辅助驾驶功能，以及包括自动驾驶豪华轿车在内的 未来 SAE-L4 级自动驾驶应用的开发 。 IT之家从公告获悉，除辅助驾驶外，梅赛德斯-奔驰还在汽车工程仿真及数字化生产生态系统 MO360 中采用英伟达技术，应用范围涵盖虚拟规划和 AI 应用等。双方正共同努力，进一步提升梅赛德斯-奔驰全球生产网络的效率、灵活性与质量。
items.summary_en: Mercedes-Benz and Nvidia are expanding their strategic partnership to co-develop next-generation driver assistance, pairing the automaker's MB.OS and safety engineering with Nvidia's Hyperion compute architecture, Alpamayo driving software stack and Halos safety system. The collaboration targets advanced driver assistance and future SAE Level 4 applications, and extends to simulation and the MO360 digital production ecosystem.
items.why_zh: 传统车企与 AI 算力巨头的深度绑定，正决定 L3/L4 级自动驾驶的落地节奏。
items.why_en: Deep ties between automakers and AI compute leaders are setting the pace for L3/L4 autonomous driving deployment.

items.title_zh: Disney Asked Character.AI to Go Bankrupt for a Get-Out-of-Lawsuits Card
items.title_en: Report: Disney Pushed for Character.AI Bankruptcy as a Way Out of Lawsuits
items.summary_zh: Disney Asked Character.AI to Go Bankrupt for a Get-Out-of-Lawsuits Card WIRED
items.summary_en: WIRED reports that Disney pressed for Character.AI to go bankrupt as a way out of the litigation between them, framing it as a strategic move in a dispute over characters and copyrighted content. The report highlights the mounting friction between entertainment giants and generative AI companies over IP licensing.
items.why_zh: 版权方与 AI 公司的对抗升级，其结果将直接影响角色类 AI 产品的商业模式与合规边界。
items.why_en: Escalating IP-holder versus AI-company conflicts will shape the business model and legal boundaries of character-based AI products.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek 上线搜索 API？智能体抓取暴增如何测准 ROI
items.title_en: Rumored DeepSeek Search API Raises the Question: Measuring ROI as AI Agent Crawling Surges
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 上线搜索 API？智能体抓取暴增如何测准 ROI openinstall
items.summary_en: Reports suggest DeepSeek has launched a search API, potentially giving developers a new way to build agents with real-time retrieval. Alongside it, surging crawler traffic from AI agents is complicating attribution and ROI measurement, prompting debate over how to separate genuine user behavior from automated access.
items.why_zh: 当 AI 智能体成为网站的主要访问者，传统的流量归因与投放 ROI 评估方法必须重写。
items.why_en: If AI agents become the dominant visitors to websites, conventional traffic attribution and ROI measurement must be rewritten.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek发布新模型 称成为新的最优性价比模型
items.title_en: DeepSeek Releases New Model, Calls It the New Best Cost-Performance Model
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek发布新模型 称成为新的最优性价比模型 财新
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has released a new model and claims it sets a new benchmark for cost-effectiveness, according to Caixin. Few technical details, benchmarks, or pricing information were disclosed in the initial report.
items.why_zh: DeepSeek 一贯以低成本高性能路线影响行业定价，新模型的性价比主张可能再次压低同类模型的调用成本预期。
items.why_en: DeepSeek's low-cost, high-performance approach has repeatedly influenced industry pricing, and its new cost-effectiveness claim could again reset expectations for model inference costs.

items.title_zh: 豆包回应“国内超一半算力在造爽剧”：字节只有约10%算力用于视频生成模型的训练和推理
items.title_en: Doubao Responds to Claim That Over Half of China's Compute Goes to Short Dramas: ByteDance Uses Only About 10% for Video Generation Models
items.summary_zh: 豆包回应“国内超一半算力在造爽剧”：字节只有约10%算力用于视频生成模型的训练和推理 ThePaper.cn
items.summary_en: Doubao pushed back on claims that more than half of China's compute is being spent generating short dramas, saying ByteDance devotes only about 10% of its compute to training and inference for video generation models, ThePaper.cn reported.
items.why_zh: 在算力被视为稀缺资源的背景下，这一回应给出了视频生成在大厂算力盘子里占比的官方口径，有助于校正外界对 AI 算力去向的估算。
items.why_en: With compute treated as a scarce resource, the response offers an official estimate of how much of a major firm's capacity goes to video generation, helping correct outside assumptions about where AI compute is spent.

items.title_zh: 面向个性化 LLM 路由的机会约束方法：在线偏好学习
items.title_en: Chance-Constrained Personalized LLM Routing with Online Preference Learning
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文研究个性化 LLM 路由问题：路由器需要在成本与能力各异的多个异构模型之间做选择，目标是在最小化累计推理成本的同时，保证实际响应质量可靠。由于用户偏好未知、只能在部署过程中通过反馈逐步学习，作者将该问题建模为带约束的上下文赌博机（contextual bandit），并提出一种在成本与质量之间权衡、同时学习偏好的算法。在逻辑偏好模型与严格可行性条件下，论文给出了次线性（sublinear）的遗憾界等理论结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22695v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study personalized LLM routing, where a router selects among heterogeneous models with different costs and capabilities. The router must minimize cumulative inference cost while ensuring reliable realized response quality, even though user preferences are unknown and must be learned from feedback during deployment. We formulate this problem as a constrained contextual bandit and develop an algorithm that learns preferences while balancing cost and quality. Under a logistic preference model and a strict-feasibility condition, we establish subli…
items.why_zh: 随着应用同时调用多个模型，如何在未知用户偏好下既省钱又不牺牲质量，正成为 LLM 系统落地的关键工程与理论问题。
items.why_en: As applications increasingly call multiple models, saving cost without sacrificing quality under unknown user preferences is becoming a key practical and theoretical problem for deploying LLM systems.

items.title_zh: 归一化流映射（Normalizing Flow Maps）：兼顾少步生成与可计算似然
items.title_en: Normalizing Flow Maps
items.summary_zh: 扩散模型、流匹配与少步生成器构成了当前生成建模的主流“流映射”路线，但这些先进模型难以获得显式的模型密度。与此同时，归一化流、自回归模型等经典方法虽具备可计算的似然，却在采样效率上受限。该论文试图把两条线索合并，提出 Normalizing Flow Maps（NFM），在保持少步生成能力的同时提供可处理的样本似然，从而让这类生成模型重新具备密度估计与概率推断能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22711v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scalable approaches to learning neural dynamical systems have placed diffusion, flow matching, and few-step generators in flow maps at the forefront of generative modeling. Such state-of-the-art models have limited access to explicit model densities despite evolving from classical generative modeling approaches that leveraged tractable likelihoods, e.g., Normalizing Flows and Autoregressive models. In this paper, we combine these threads of few-step generation and tractable sample likelihoods and introduce Normalizing Flow Maps (NFM), a class of…
items.why_zh: 让高质量少步生成模型重新拥有可计算似然，对密度估计、不确定性量化和概率推理等下游任务意义重大。
items.why_en: Restoring tractable likelihoods to high-quality few-step generative models matters for density estimation, uncertainty quantification, and probabilistic inference.

items.title_zh: 学习被引导：为无分类器引导塑造潜空间几何
items.title_en: Learning to Be Guided: Shaping Latent Geometry for Classifier-Free Guidance
items.summary_zh: 无分类器引导（CFG）是条件扩散模型的标准组件，引导生成效果几乎已成为衡量模型是否达到 SOTA 的默认指标。近期关于潜扩散模型的研究致力于学习更易于被扩散建模的潜空间，但论文指出：在 CFG 下，生成效果还取决于条件在潜空间中如何排布。作者以离散类别条件为对象研究这种“类几何”（class geometry），探讨何种类几何能让潜空间更适合引导生成，并据此提出塑造潜空间几何的方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22885v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is a standard component of conditional diffusion models, and guided generation performance has become the \textit{de facto} measure of state-of-the-art models. Recent work on latent diffusion models seeks to learn latent spaces that are easier to model with diffusion. However, under CFG, generation additionally depends on how conditions are arranged in the latent space. We study this arrangement under discrete class conditions, termed \emph{class geometry}, and investigate what class geometry allows a latent space t…
items.why_zh: 它把 CFG 的效果从“训练目标问题”拓展为“潜空间结构问题”，为提升条件生成质量提供了新的可优化维度。
items.why_en: It reframes CFG performance as a latent-space structure problem rather than only a training-objective one, offering a new optimization axis for conditional generation.

items.title_zh: HiPredict：用机器学习预测 HiRISE 缺失的 RED4 光谱通道
items.title_en: HiPredict: Predicting the missing HiRISE RED4 spectral channel with machine learning
items.summary_zh: 火星勘测轨道飞行器（MRO）上的高分辨率成像科学实验（HiRISE）以 25–30 厘米/像素的分辨率拍摄火星，支撑地质、气候历史与着陆点评估等研究。其焦平面组件包含 14 个探测器，部分探测器相互重叠，从而可获取三通道彩色红外影像，用于识别成分差异与研究地表活动过程。2023 年，焦平面中央的一个探测器（RED4）出现异常，导致该通道数据缺失。论文提出 HiPredict，利用机器学习预测缺失的 RED4 通道，以延续相关科学观测数据的可用性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.23335v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (HiRISE) onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO) acquires imagery of Mars at 25--30 cm/pixel, supporting studies of martian geology, climate history, and landing-site characterization. Its 14-detector focal plane assembly includes several overlapping detectors that enable the acquisition of three-channel colour-infrared images, which are important for identifying compositional variations and studying active surface processes. In 2023, a detector in the center of the focal plane assembly (RED4)…
items.why_zh: 用机器学习补全在轨仪器损坏后缺失的光谱通道，可在硬件无法修复的情况下延续行星科学观测数据的完整性。
items.why_en: Using ML to reconstruct a spectral channel lost to an instrument failure keeps planetary science datasets usable when hardware cannot be repaired.

items.title_zh: 从延迟单边反馈中学习个性化记忆门控
items.title_en: Learning Personalized Memory Gating from Delayed One-Sided Feedback
items.summary_zh: 长期记忆让语言模型智能体能够在后续交互中实现个性化，但有限的记忆库无法保存所有抽取出的事实。现有记忆门控策略通常在用户之间共享，因而无法反映不同用户各自的事实复用模式。论文在“事实”层面研究记忆门控：先提出一种基于检索的标注策略，用某条事实之后是否被检索并写入回答来为其打标签；随后把在线记忆门控建模为上下文“苹果品尝”（contextual apple tasting）问题，以应对反馈延迟且仅能观测到单边信息的情形。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.23812v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-term memory enables language-model agents to personalize future interactions, but a finite memory bank cannot preserve every extracted fact. Existing memory gating policies are typically shared across users and therefore fail to account for user-specific patterns of future reuse. In this paper, we study memory gating at the fact level. We first propose a retrieval-based labeling strategy that labels each fact by whether it is later retrieved and incorporated into responses. We then formulate online memory gating as contextual apple tasting w…
items.why_zh: 个性化记忆的关键不只是“记住什么”，而是为每个用户学会“何时该留、何时该忘”，该工作把这一问题转化为可在线学习的决策问题。
items.why_en: Personalized memory hinges on learning per-user when to keep or drop facts, and this work turns that into an online learnable decision problem.

items.title_zh: CoLU：面向大语言模型的置信度加权分层遗忘
items.title_en: CoLU: Confidence-Weighted Layerwise Unlearning for Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型遗忘（unlearning）旨在无需从头重训的情况下忘掉特定信息并保留其他能力。NPO、SimNPO、SatImp 等 SoTA 方法通过全模型微调来平衡“遗忘”与“保留”，FOM-UL 则探索选择性层更新。已有研究表明，压制目标信息可能损伤被保留的知识，而且在同一遗忘损失下，这种权衡在不同层之间可能存在差异。为此作者提出 Confidence-Weighted Layerwise Unlearning（CoLU），结合一种新的置信度度量实现分层加权的遗忘更新。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22721v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM) unlearning aims to forget certain information while preserving others, without retraining from scratch. SoTA methods such as NPO, SimNPO, and SatImp balance forgetting and retain through whole model fine-tuning, while FOM-UL explores selective layer updates. Prior works show that suppressing target information can damage retained knowledge. This trade-off can vary across layers even under the same unlearning loss. In this work, we propose Confidence-Weighted Layerwise Unlearning (CoLU), which combines a novel confiden…
items.why_zh: 遗忘与保留的权衡在不同层并不相同，按层并按置信度加权更新，有望在满足合规删除需求的同时减少模型能力损失。
items.why_en: Since the forget-retain trade-off varies by layer, confidence-weighted layerwise updates could meet deletion requirements while limiting damage to model capabilities.

items.title_zh: 基于深度学习的香蕉甲虫损伤高效检测方法
items.title_en: An Efficient Approach to Beetle Damage Detection of Banana Using Deep Learning
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文提出了一种基于 YOLOv8n 的轻量级框架，用于在图像中定位单根香蕉并判断其表面可见状况为健康或不健康。研究指出，香蕉果实表面的疤痕状损伤会降低其市场价值，而人工检查主观性强且难以规模化。值得注意的是，论文标题中的“甲虫损伤”只是对当地观察到的疤痕状表面状况的操作性称呼，模型本身并不识别具体害虫种类。该工作为果实表面缺陷的自动化分拣提供了低成本方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.23661v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Visible surface damage of banana fruits by Basilepta subcostata (the banana fruit scarring beetle) can reduce their market value. Here, manual inspection of Banana fruits is subjective and difficult to scale. This study presents a lightweight framework based on YOLOv8n deep learning model for locating individual bananas and classifying their visible surface condition as healthy or unhealthy. The term beetle damage in the paper title is used operationally for the locally observed scar-like surface condition; the model does not identify a specifi…
items.why_zh: 它展示了轻量级目标检测模型在农产品自动分拣中的实用价值，同时明确界定了模型能力的边界。
items.why_en: It shows how lightweight object-detection models can support automated produce sorting, while being explicit about the model's limits.

items.title_zh: 利用3D药效团进行生成式分子演化，助力基于结构的药物设计
items.title_en: Generative molecule evolution using 3D pharmacophore for efficient Structure-Based Drug Design
items.summary_zh: 针对基于结构的药物设计（SBDD）面临的两大难题——高质量蛋白-配体复合物数据稀缺、生成分子难以实际合成——研究者提出生成式分子演化方法 MEVO。该方法借助 3D 药效团信息，在利用大规模小分子数据的同时保留靶点蛋白的结构上下文，从而弥补纯配体方法的不足。论文将其定位为缓解数据稀缺与合成可及性问题的统一方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2507.20130v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent breakthroughs in generative models have shown great promise for drug discovery, yet Structure-Based Drug Design (SBDD) faces two critical challenges: the scarcity of high-quality protein-ligand complex data and the practical synthesizability of generated molecules. While ligand-based approaches benefit from billion-scale small molecule datasets, they often lack the structural context of the target protein. To address these dual challenges of data scarcity and synthetic inaccessibility, we propose MEVO, a generative molecular evolutiona…
items.why_zh: 它尝试同时解决药物生成中的数据稀缺与可合成性两大痛点，对生成式药物设计落地至关重要。
items.why_en: It targets both data scarcity and synthesizability, two bottlenecks that determine whether generative drug design is practically usable.

items.title_zh: 经验贝叶斯多臂老虎机学习
items.title_en: Empirical Bayesian Multi-Bandit Learning
items.summary_zh: 论文关注上下文老虎机中的多任务学习，提出一种分层贝叶斯框架来同时刻画多个老虎机实例之间的异质性与相关性。该框架通过分层建模实现实例间的有效信息共享，同时保留各实例自身的特性。作者称，这一思路可提升多个相关任务上的决策表现，并适应不同实例的具体情形。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2510.26284v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multi-task learning in contextual bandits has attracted significant research interest due to its potential to enhance decision-making across multiple related tasks by leveraging shared structures and task-specific heterogeneity. In this article, we propose a novel hierarchical Bayesian framework for learning in various bandit instances. This framework captures both the heterogeneity and the correlations among different bandit instances through a hierarchical Bayesian model, enabling effective information sharing while accommodating instance-s…
items.why_zh: 在多个相关决策任务间合理共享信息，是提升老虎机算法样本效率的关键方向。
items.why_en: Sharing information sensibly across related decision tasks is key to improving the sample efficiency of bandit algorithms.

items.title_zh: CastFlow：打通证据获取与精准预测的智能体式时间序列预测
items.title_en: CastFlow: Bridging Evidence Acquisition and Accurate Prediction in Agentic Time Series Forecasting
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体为时间序列预测带来了新范式，可通过自主调用工具并进行有证据支撑的推理，但仍有两个核心难题：如何通过自适应工具交互获取与预测相关的证据，以及如何把证据转化为准确的数值预测。为此作者提出 CastFlow，一个角色分工的智能体预测框架，试图将通用工具推理与数值预测环节衔接起来。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.27840v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Time series forecasting is a fundamental task in temporal data analytics, and large language model (LLM)-based agents offer a promising paradigm through autonomous tool interaction and evidence-grounded reasoning. items.why_zh: 它直面 LLM 智能体在预测任务中“会推理但难出准数”的核心短板。
items.why_en: It addresses the core weakness of LLM agents in forecasting: strong reasoning but weak numerical accuracy.

items.title_zh: 多情境贝叶斯优化中按情境条件化的评估方法

items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.04895v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Published transfer-BO comparisons often estimate an average treatment effect of acquisition choice over hidden regime variables, while practitioners need the conditional effect for their specific prior quality, budget ratio, and metric. An audit of 40 transfer-BO papers from NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AISTATS, UAI, TMLR, JMLR, and AutoML-Conf (2022-2025) finds that 98% never vary B/|A| as a controlled axis. items.why_zh: 它揭示了迁移贝叶斯优化评测中的系统性盲点：结论可能只在特定预算情境下成立。
items.why_en: It exposes a systematic blind spot in transfer-BO evaluation: conclusions may hold only under specific budget regimes.

items.title_zh: 超越固定采集函数：用于扰动发现的时序差分主动学习

items.summary_zh: 论文指出，基因与药物扰动筛选是阐明疾病机制、验证治疗靶点的重要手段，但实验成本限制了可测试候选的数量。现有筛选方法通常在利用反馈更新代理模型的同时保持采集函数不变，因而难以根据不同的响应景观调整选择策略。作者提出基于时序差分的主动学习方法，让实验反馈既更新候选预测，也反过来指导后续选择。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22122v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Genetic and drug perturbation screens are important tools for elucidating disease mechanisms and validating therapeutic targets, but experimental costs limit the number of candidates that can be tested. Existing perturbation screening methods typically update the surrogate model with feedback while keeping the acquisition function fixed, limiting their ability to adapt selection to different response landscapes. Experimental feedback reveals current hits and informs subsequent selection by updating candidate predictions, providing a training…
items.why_zh: 让采集策略随实验反馈自适应变化，有望在有限实验预算下更快找到有效扰动。
items.why_en: Making acquisition adaptive to experimental feedback could find useful perturbations faster under limited budgets.

items.title_zh: 无需重训练的跨方言泛化：MLIR 模式派生约束解码的基准与评估
items.title_en: Cross-Dialect Generalization Without Retraining: Benchmarks and Evaluation of Schema-Derived Constrained Decoding for MLIR
items.summary_zh: MLIR 是现代 ML 编译基础设施（TensorFlow、JAX/StableHLO、PyTorch Inductor、IREE）的底层支撑，但在代码语言模型预训练语料中占比极低。由于 MLIR 设计上可扩展、新方言按应用领域不断出现，为每种方言单独微调模型并不现实。作者提出的问题是：从各方言的算子定义规范（ODS）机械推导出的推理时先验，能否替代基于梯度的适配。为此他们发布了四个自然语言基准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.18254v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Multi-Level Intermediate Representation (MLIR) underlies modern ML compiler infrastructure (TensorFlow, JAX/StableHLO, PyTorch Inductor, IREE), yet appears only in trace amounts in code-LM pretraining corpora. MLIR is also extensible by design: new dialects ship per application domain, so a fine-tuned model per dialect does not scale. We ask whether inference-time priors derived mechanically from each dialect's Operation Definition Specification (ODS) can substitute for gradient-based adaptation. First, we release four natural-language-…
items.why_zh: 若能以免训练方式泛化到新编译器方言，将大幅降低代码模型适配 MLIR 生态的成本。
items.why_en: If models can generalize to new compiler dialects without training, adapting code models to the MLIR ecosystem becomes far cheaper.

items.summary_zh: 射电技术签名搜寻依赖机器学习探测器在人工查看前缩小候选范围，但这类模型通常在训练分布的留出数据上验证，恰恰排除了最易失败的场景：技术签名形态未知，地面干扰种类无穷。作者训练了一个标准竞赛级探测器后将其冻结，向真实绿岸望远镜背景中注入 15,000 个信号，覆盖十种形态与五种幅度进行探测。结果揭示了两个方向上的失效模式（漏检与虚警）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22050v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Radio technosignature searches rely on machine learning detectors to shrink the candidate pool before a human looks at it. items.why_en: It warns that reported ML detector performance can badly overstate real-world reliability in out-of-distribution settings.
